Lady Annalie: Welcome, welcome~
Lady Annalie: Let me finish things here really quick and we are good to go, ok?
You: Sure, no problem.
Lady Annalie: So anyway. Who is that girl we are going to meet?
You: Well, she’s-
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Lady Annalie: Wait! {{punch}}I changed my mind! No Spoilers! I wouldn’t want to ruin surprise~
#Annalie.face.normal
You: Please, don’t weird her out. She already thinks that I’m a creep.
Lady Annalie: Well, she isn’t far from the truth I would say. Besides, if she’s willing to meet with you her opinion of you can’t be that bad, right?
You: I guess so, but there are other circumstances…
Lady Annalie: I bet there are,
Lady Annalie: Alright! I’m closing up the register and we are ready to go!
